papers.title_en: On the Complexity of Linear Programs with Parametric Constraint Matrices
papers.authors: Laurie Boveroux, Margarida Carvalho, Andrea Lodi, Quentin Louveaux
papers.evidence: 解决参数线性规划中的两个双层规划问题
papers.tldr: 本文研究了约束矩阵包含线性标量参数的线性规划问题，旨在计算固定参数范围内的最小和最大最优值。作者证明了这两个双层规划问题的判定版本均为NP完全问题，识别了三种简化条件，提出了问题重构方法，并通过实验揭示了计算极小值与极大值之间的计算复杂度不对称现象。
papers.abstract_en: While sensitivity analysis for linear programs with parametric right- hand side vectors is well established, cases involving parametric constraint matrices remain less explored. To address this gap, we investigate linear programs where the constraint matrix depends linearly on a scalar parameter. Our goal is to compute the minimum and maximum optimal values of these parametric linear programs within a fixed parameter range. This corresponds to solving two bilevel programs. We show that both decision versions of these optimization problems are NP-complete by proving both NP-hardness and membership in NP. We additionally identify three sufficient conditions on the parametric matrix under which the bilevel programs are no longer NP-hard. We introduce a reformulation for both problems, together with a Farkas-based certificate for the lower-level feasibility condition, and compare the execution time for solving them on standard benchmark instances. The experiments highlight a practical dichotomy. Although both bilevel optimizations are NP-hard, computing the parameter value corresponding to the minimum of the linear program is fast, whereas computing the value corresponding to the maximum is not. We relate this asymmetry to the parametric equality constraints, whose free dual variables leave the relaxation of the maximum reformulation unbounded.

papers.title_en: Observability as a constraint qualification for a nonsmooth bilevel PDE-constrained problem
papers.authors: Christian Clason, Alberto Domínguez Corella, Jyrki Jauhiainen
papers.evidence: 对具有稀疏反演的非光滑双层控制问题的分析
papers.tldr: 本文研究了一个包含底层稀疏反演的非光滑双层PDE约束优化问题，该问题源于图像重建中的参数辨识实验设计。作者通过刻画提升约束集的一阶几何对象，证明了耦合系统的可观测性条件或接触集的勒贝格零测性可作为合格性条件，并在此基础上提出了一种简化梯度法及数值实验验证。
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by experiment design for parameter identification in image reconstruction, we analyze a bilevel control problem involving sparse inversion at the lower level. Qualified optimality conditions in explicit multiplier form are shown to hold under either an observability condition for a coupled system or the Lebesgue nullity of a contact set induced by the lower-level adjoint variable. We prove that these conditions are independent of one another and that they cannot, in general, both be omitted. The approach is based on the characterization of local first-order geometric objects (tangent and normal cones) associated with a set of lifted constraints. Based on the resulting optimality conditions, we formulate a reduced gradient method and illustrate it through numerical experiments.

papers.title_en: SCOPE: Semantic Bounded Credit Optimization for Prompt Engineering in Text-to-image Generation
papers.authors: Yufei Jiao, Jinfa Huang, Zeyue Xue, Tianyu Xie, Yuexiao Ma, Rongrong Ji, Xiawu Zheng, Jiebo Luo
papers.evidence: 使用强化学习自动重写提示词
papers.tldr: 本论文针对文生图提示词工程提出了一种名为SCOPE的语义有界信用优化方法。传统强化学习方法对所有子词标记应用单一图像反馈，忽略了对象的语义结构。SCOPE通过联合生成增强提示词与其语义划分，在保持整体优势不变的同时，将策略对数概率的变化在每个语义跨度内进行聚合，从而优化信用分配。在多个主流模型上的实验表明，该方法显著提升了图像生成的对齐能力和组合生成性能。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables language models to improve text-to-image (T2I) generation by rewriting prompts for a frozen image generator. Existing methods typically apply a single signal derived from the image to individual subword tokens, although objects, counts, attributes, and relations form coherent semantic spans. We propose SCOPE, an objective based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) that aligns update weighting with this structure. The rewriter jointly generates an enhanced prompt and its semantic partition. SCOPE pools shifts in policy log probabilities within each span to derive a shared coefficient for its token losses while retaining a single advantage for each completion. It requires neither separate span rewards nor additional image renders. Across Qwen-Image, SD3, and FLUX.1-dev, SCOPE achieves average relative gains over vanilla GRPO of 9.48% on GeneVal and 7.62% on T2I-CompBench. Ablation studies show that both semantic boundaries and pooling within spans contribute to these gains, supporting semantic structure as a practical inductive bias for prompt engineering with RL.

papers.title_en: From Copying to Composition: How Language Models Develop In-Context Learning
papers.authors: Minglai Yang, Xinyu Guo, Renxiong Wang, Sunjie Hou, Daniel Yue Zhang, Yunzhong He
papers.evidence: 上下文学习与提示词示例
papers.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型如何通过提示词中的指令和示范来发展上下文学习（ICL）能力。通过设计区分“复制邻近示范”与“跨提示词整合信息”的诊断方法，分析了17个模型及训练检查点，发现ICL并非单一均匀的能力，其提示控制、答案偏好和迁移能力遵循不同的发展轨迹。
papers.abstract_en: In-context learning (ICL) allows language models to adapt their behavior from instructions and demonstrations in a prompt, but accuracy alone does not reveal how contextual information controls their predictions. We study the acquisition and trainability of ICL with a controlled diagnostic that separates copying a nearby demonstration from integrating information across the prompt. Across 17 models, about a third prefer the copied answer, a few are undecided, and the rest prefer the rule-consistent answer, which goes with higher accuracy and with control by the requested value rather than the closest conflicting example. Checkpoint analyses show that models begin prioritizing task-relevant prompt tokens over conflicting examples long before their accuracy improves beyond chance level. In matched training experiments, synthetic documents that define endings and then query them shift models toward compositional responses on the controlled diagnostic, whereas fine-tuning on definition exercises built from rewritten real documents improves accuracy when prompts reassign label meanings. The results suggest that ICL is not acquired as a single, uniform capability. Instead, prompt control, answer preference, construction without candidates, and transfer can develop along distinct trajectories.

papers.title_en: MemComposer: Learning to Assemble Memories for LLM Agents via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Yixuan Xie, Xueqiang Xu, Xinyi Fan, Xinxi Lyu, Tao Feng, Xing Fan, Chenlei Guo, Jie Hao, Shaowen Wang, Jiashuo Sun, Jiawei Han
papers.evidence: 学习为大模型智能体组装记忆
papers.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为MemComposer的LLM智能体记忆组装框架，旨在解决传统基于语义相似度检索记忆的局限性。通过引入强化学习方法Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO)，该方法能够联合评估当前查询与候选记忆，自主决定记忆的筛选、数量与排序。实验表明，MemComposer在减少token消耗的同时显著提升了任务成功率，并具备良好的泛化能力。
papers.abstract_en: Agent memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to reuse past experiences without updating their parameters. However, semantic similarity alone does not guarantee memory usefulness: downstream performance depends on how memories are selected and presented to the agent. We propose MemComposer, a memory composer that jointly examines the current query and retrieved candidates to decide which experiences to include, how many to select, and how to order them. We train the composer using Experience Policy Optimization (ExPO), a GRPO-based framework that evaluates assembled memory contexts through complete agent interactions and uses task-success feedback to optimize the assembly policy. Across three $τ^2$-bench domains with two frozen executors, MemComposer outperforms the strongest baseline for each executor while reducing average memory-token usage by 16.9% and 4.9%, respectively. The learned policy also transfers to unseen domains, executors, and memory banks, and benefits from memories generated by stronger models without further training. These results demonstrate the value of learning query-specific memory assembly using downstream task feedback.

papers.title_en: Personalized Projected Ascent for Federated Stackelberg Optimization
papers.authors: M Yashwanth, Sharannya Ghosh, Saikiran Bulusu, Anirban Chakraborty
papers.evidence: 联邦 Stackelberg 优化和极小极大问题
papers.tldr: 本文研究了联邦Stackelberg优化问题，针对传统方法在处理客户端私有最大化变量时的不适定性，提出了一种个性化投影上升方案和VR-SGDA算法。该研究在非凸-凹和非凸-PL设定下分析了收敛性，并通过方差缩减技术消除了噪声底限，实验验证了其在鲁棒性和追踪机制上的优势。
papers.abstract_en: Federated minimax problems, such as distributionally robust optimization and adversarial training, include an inner maximization variable built from each client's local data. These variables differ in meaning and dimension from one client to the next, so averaging them across clients, as standard federated minimax methods do, is ill-posed. We therefore study a federated minimax problem where the minimization variable $\mathbf{x}$ is shared and aggregated, while each client retains the maximization variable $\mathbf{y}_i$ (personalized). Because these applications constrain $\mathbf{y}_i$ to a compact convex set, we analyze projected ascent directly. We show that, in the nonconvex-concave regime, this projected personalized scheme attains the standard sublinear rate. In the nonconvex-PL regime, however, it hits a stepsize-invariant noise floor due to stochastic $\mathbf{y}_i$ updates. To mitigate this, we propose VR-SGDA, incorporating a variance-reduced ascent step where each client maintains a private variable snapshot. By evaluating current and snapshot gradients on the same sample, the constant variance is replaced by a vanishing drift under a two-timescale regime. VR-SGDA eliminates the noise floor, attaining sublinear leading rates while preserving personalization and projection. Experiments on subpopulation-robustness and NLP adversarial training confirm both the worst-group robustness benefits and the two-timescale tracking mechanism.

papers.title_en: Multi-Target Few-Shot Prompting with Diffusion Language Models
papers.authors: Anton Xue, Alan Li, Rahul Saha
papers.evidence: 扩散语言模型的少样本提示
papers.tldr: 本文针对传统因果自回归模型在处理依赖左右上下文的多点文本编辑时表现不佳的问题，引入了基于扩散语言模型的多目标少样本提示方法。该方法通过在共享画布中利用示例引导多个掩码区域的填充，并结合选择性掩码衍生似然比奖励来增强对示例的遵循能力，从而提升少样本提示的准确性。
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot prompting is useful when instructions and rewards are hard to specify. One such application is editing by example, where a demonstrated formatting change or API migration may need to be applied across multiple sites. However, such edits often depend on both left and right context, making generation with causal autoregressive models awkward. We therefore introduce multi-target few-shot prompting with diffusion language models, where examples guide the infilling of multiple masked regions within a shared canvas. To address the known challenge of reliably following demonstrations in few-shot prompting, we further leverage selective masking of the canvas to derive a likelihood-ratio reward that favors example-supported infills. Across few-shot prompting benchmarks and software refactoring case studies, we find that demonstrations improve infilling accuracy, with example guidance yielding further gains in several settings.

papers.title_en: Self-improving data synthesis enables scalable adaptation of embedding models
papers.authors: Zucan Lyu, Rui Tang, Jianlyu Chen, Peisheng Jin, Defu Lian
papers.evidence: 合成指令的自我改进框架
papers.tldr: 本文介绍了SYNTRA，一个用于嵌入模型可扩展自适应的智能体数据合成框架。通过从未标记语料库和少量示例中推断信息需求并利用反馈精炼指令，SYNTRA能自动生成高质量的训练数据，显著提升嵌入模型在多个领域的检索性能，且几乎不需要人工干预。
papers.abstract_en: AI agents require specialised retrieval across domains and tasks, but adapting embedding models is constrained by costly manual training-data design. Here we introduce SYNTRA, a self-improving agentic framework that turns a few retrieval examples into reusable synthesis instructions. Given an unlabelled corpus and a few relevant query-document pairs, SYNTRA infers implicit information needs and relevance criteria, then uses feedback on trial outputs to refine instructions for query generation and relevance assessment. Experiments across 24 datasets spanning 15 domains demonstrate that the same synthesis workflow produces effective training data, benefiting even strong embedding models with and without existing labelled training sets. Self-improvement strengthens this supervision on all six evaluated tasks, yielding better retrieval than human calibration on four. The training value persists at larger scales: on MS MARCO, retrieval gains continue across a 32-fold range of synthetic training-data sizes. SYNTRA thus enables scalable embedding-model adaptation with minimal human intervention.

papers.title_en: ActICL: Post-Training for Agentic Multimodal In-Context Learning
papers.authors: Yanshu Li, Ruixiang Tang, Junyi Jessy Li, Elias Stengel-Eskin
papers.evidence: 智能体多模态上下文学习
papers.tldr: 多模态上下文学习（ICL）的性能高度依赖于示例检索。传统方法多采用固定评分一次性检索，易引入冗余和噪声。为此，本文提出了ActICL，通过后训练使多模态大模型成为智能体，利用工具增强的推理能力自主进行渐进式、有针对性的示例检索与过滤，显著提升了多模态ICL的性能。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal in-context learning (ICL) is an important capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Its performance is closely tied to the demonstrations it uses, making demonstration retrieval a core problem for ICL. Common methods use fixed scoring methods to retrieve all the demonstrations at once, which may introduce redundancy and noise. Context-aware retrieval methods have emerged to address this problem by allowing incremental retrieval from a growing context. However, none of them lets the MLLM learn how to judge what new demonstrations it needs and then carry out progressive retrieval on its own. To this end, we introduce ActICL, which trains an MLLM agent to acquire and use an ICL context via tool-augmented reasoning. An ActICL agent analyzes its own information gaps during iterative reasoning and tool-use actions. Based on these gaps, it performs targeted retrieval to acquire a set of initial candidates. It can then use the existing context to further filter the candidates and refine the context, or it can iteratively perform a new retrieval. When the agent judges that the context is sufficient for the task, or when the resource limit is reached with the user request met, it sends the acquired context to an answering model, either the agent itself or another MLLM. We use a two-stage post-training procedure that jointly optimizes the agent's acquisition and answering. With an adaptive number of demonstrations, ActICL improves average performance by 11.6 percentage points over standard similarity-based retrieval across seven benchmarks and three MLLMs, and by 4.4 points compared to the strongest prior baseline. The contexts acquired by ActICL agents can also be used effectively by frontier models. When GPT-5.6-Sol performs 4-shot ICL, ActICL's contexts improve its performance by 3.5 points over standard retrieval, averaged over three benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Towards Continual Learning: Mitigating Forgetting With Subspace Tuning
papers.authors: Arnav Chavan, Kusha Sareen, Rishabh Tiwari, Abhranil Chandra, Johan Obando-Ceron, Kurt Keutzer, Scott Niekum, Inderjit S Dhillon, Devvrit Khatri
papers.evidence: 大语言模型的参数高效子空间微调
papers.tldr: 本文针对大语言模型持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出了一种名为子空间微调（SST）的新方法。该方法通过将权重更新限制在底部奇异子空间中，避免了对主方向的改动，从而在保持目标任务强大性能的同时显著减少了遗忘，推动了学习与遗忘的帕累托前沿。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) acquire new skills through fine-tuning, but it can destroy capabilities they already have: catastrophic forgetting remains a central obstacle to continual learning in LLMs. Recent works connect forgetting to how far, and along which directions, fine-tuning moves the weights. On-policy methods such as reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation avoid updating the principal singular directions of weight matrices and thus forget less. In contrast, SFT concentrates updates along these directions and is susceptible to catastrophic forgetting. In this work, we introduce Subspace Tuning (SST), which restricts each weight update to the bottom singular subspace, eliminating changes along the principal directions. SST is optimizer-agnostic and composes well with fine-tuning recipes including SFT and self-distillation. SST combines tight subspace protection, dense gradient estimation, and a simple refresh mechanism, enabling stronger learning than prior orthogonal fine-tuning methods. With these mechanisms, protecting as much as 99\% of the weight subspace substantially improves retention while preserving strong target-task performance. This behavior strengthens with model and data size and nearly eliminates forgetting in the large-model regime. SST also keeps the model close to its base distribution, inducing $2$--$4\times$ less KL drift than the baseline recipes. Overall, SST advances the learning--forgetting Pareto frontier, making it a practical default for fine-tuning pre-trained language models.
